newsitem.title: USA: Sharper Image sees boost from new products.
newsitem.headline: Sharper Image sees boost from new products.

text.p: Sharper Image Corp said Thursday it expects a sales boost from new products in the next six to nine months.
Total store sales for the first quarter were $25.6 million compared with $26.1 million for the same period a year ago.
Comparable store sales decreased four percent to $23.7 million from $24.6 million. Catalog sales increased four percent to $9.9 million from $9.5 million.
The company said its stores have not yet benefited from new products, since many of them have been made for catalogs only.
The company said its focus for 1997 is to drive higher sales through a better merchandise mix and inventory, with a longer term commitment to improving the gross margin rate.
The company reported first quarter loss per share was $0.26 compared with a loss of $0.27 for the same period a year ago.
